v1.0.1-preview.4
- Migrated BlazorRemoteConfigIndexedDbInterop to lazy ES-module import via Lazy<Task<IJSObjectReference>> for thread-safe concurrent access
- Added dual disposal (IDisposable + IAsyncDisposable) to BlazorLifecycleMonitor
- Added JSDisconnectedException handling in disposal for all interop classes

v1.0.1-preview.3
- Added BlazorVisibilityMonitor implementing IRealtimeLifecycleMonitor: monitors document.visibilitychange via IJSRuntime to disconnect the realtime stream when the tab is hidden and reconnect when visible.
- Registered by UseBlazor() to replace the no-op IRealtimeLifecycleMonitor default.

v1.0.1-preview.2
- Added BlazorRemoteConfigHeadersInterceptor to strip browser-unsafe headers (X-Firebase-RC-Fetch-Type, X-Google-GFE-Can-Retry, X-Accept-Response-Streaming) that trigger CORS preflight failures.
- Registered via UseBlazor() so the interceptor is only active when the Blazor integration is opted in.

v1.0.1-preview.1
- Initial release.
- IJSRuntime-based IndexedDB and localStorage persistence for Remote Config containers, settings, and metadata.
- UseBlazor() extension method on FirebaseRemoteConfigBuilder for service registration.
- Replaces in-memory stores with persistent browser storage across all Blazor hosting models (WASM, Server, Hybrid, Auto).
- Automatically configures FireForNet.Firebase.Installations.Blazor when the installation store is still the core in-memory default; explicit IInstallationStore overrides are preserved.
- IndexedDB persistence is isolated per configured database name and falls back to localStorage when IndexedDB is unavailable or security-blocked.
- No dependency on FireForNet.Firebase.RemoteConfig.Browser — uses IJSRuntime modules directly.
